title: DNS provider registry entry
description: Facts about a Domain Connect DNS provider the Scanner cannot measure. One file per providerId at providers/<a>/<b>/<providerId>.json. Every boolean is tri-state: true, false, absent or null = unknown. Consumers ignore unknown keys.

providerId.title: Provider ID
providerId.description: The providerId of the DNS provider's settings response; determines the path.

exampleDomain.title: Example domain
exampleDomain.description: A domain that completes the whole discovery flow at this provider: its _domainconnect TXT record names the provider's API and the settings response there has this providerId. Only a domain of the provider itself or one the provider lists publicly; never a customer's domain.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: The provider's logo: the address of the image, or the image embedded in the entry.

oneOf.title: Embedded logo
oneOf.description: The logo image, stored in the entry.

data.title: Image
data.description: The image file, gzip-compressed and base64-encoded.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: automatic: templates merged into the Templates repository are deployed without a request. on-request: service providers request onboarding through the onboarding contacts. other: described in the mode description.

updateSchedule.title: Update schedule
updateSchedule.description: When templates merged into the Templates repository are deployed, for example daily. Only with mode automatic.

contacts.title: Onboarding contacts
contacts.description: Where service providers request onboarding. Required, with at least one contact, with mode on-request; not allowed otherwise.

modeDescription.title: Description
modeDescription.description: How onboarding works. Only with mode other.

costDetails.title: Details
costDetails.description: What is charged and how. Only when charged is true.

agreementRequired.title: Contract, agreement or T&C acceptance required
agreementRequired.description: A contract or agreement has to be signed, or terms and conditions accepted, before onboarding.

agreementUrl.title: Agreement URL
agreementUrl.description: The agreement template, or the flow in which it is signed or accepted. Only when an agreement is required.

usesPartner.title: Uses a partner
usesPartner.description: Onboarding runs through a third party.

partners.title: Onboarding partners
partners.description: Third parties onboarding runs through. Only when uses a partner is true.

warnPhishingRejected.title: warnPhishing rejected
warnPhishingRejected.description: Templates with warnPhishing are not accepted.

signingKeyPublished.title: Signing key published
signingKeyPublished.description: The signing key has to be published.

syncRedirectUri.title: redirect_uri in the synchronous flow
syncRedirectUri.description: redirect_uri honoured in the synchronous flow.

variablesInNumberFields.title: Variables in number fields
variablesInNumberFields.description: Variables in TTL, priority, weight, port.

settings.title: Settings response
settings.description: Optional properties of the settings response. The values are per domain; only whether the provider returns them is recorded.

windowSize.title: Window size
windowSize.description: width and height of the consent window are returned.

nonStandard.title: Non-standard properties
nonStandard.description: Properties returned that the specification does not define. Empty list = none.

cnameFlattening.title: CNAME flattening
cnameFlattening.description: CNAME flattening: templates with a CNAME on the apex can be applied without host parameter set. hostRequired is ignored in this case.

links.title: Links
links.description: Generic list of links related to the entry. rel "source" marks a source the entry's data was taken from. A settings URL queried with a domain that neither belongs to the provider nor is listed publicly by it has the domain replaced by the placeholder {domain}.

rel.title: Relation
rel.description: Relation of the link to the entry, e.g. "source". Consumers ignore values they do not know.

accessed.title: Accessed
accessed.description: Date the link was last checked, YYYY-MM-DD.

consent.title: Consent to the submission terms
consent.description: I accept the submission terms of this repository (TERMS.md): I may represent the DNS provider, the data matches its actual setup, the entry holds no personal data and every contact belongs to the organisation, I keep the entry up to date, domainconnect.org may use the data and logo on its website, and Domain Connect is not liable for the content. I dedicate the entry to the public domain under CC0 1.0 (LICENSE). Given by whoever submits the entry, on every submission; CI requires it in every added or changed entry.

type.title: Type
type.description: email: value is an e-mail address. url: value is a web page. form: value is the URL of an online request form. other: free text.
